doc: Heim Rada (g04), the third Georama town. It plays the arrival run-in scenes and the time gate warp (red and blue gate rings, a white-out and a caption about jumping to the future) that sends the player to the Gundorada Workshop (f04), or to the Operations Room (s39) when event 560 is pending. It also has the exits to Heim Rada Stop (s10) and Mount Gundor (dungeon stage 4) and the hint for pending events 548 to 560.
